The '''Sith war droid Mark II''' was utilized by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] deployed these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], first during the invasion of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and later during the occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. These [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had three "feet" and four arm-mounted [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].

Shortly after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] encountered two of these droids in the city's [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]]. The two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were destroyed shortly after by [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]].
